{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Gallant Sun''''' was a [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] in service with the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. It was [[Raid on the Pendari shipyards|destroyed]] by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] forces at the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] at [[Pendari]]. The Alliance employed a [[Unidentified Pendari slicer|computer slicer]] to discover the ship's refitting schedule, and the information allowed Rebel insurgents to destroy the ship with minimal loss of life.
